purpose: Compare the pinned taroz residual exclusion/weighting order with the native raw-observable quality implementation before selecting one opt-in raw-only component.

functions/exobs.m.contract: status masks: D SNR/multipath; P SNR/code-lock/multipath/range/status; L SNR/slip/valid/multipath, plus TDCP jump

functions/exobs_residuals.m.contract: D elevation then abs(resD-dclk/obs.dt)>Dmask_res; P two-sided dDP then global system median ISB residual; L two-sided dDL

functions/obserrmodel.m.contract: MATLAB midpoint-rank p85 SNR model; P=sn_base*signal factor, D=sn_base/12, L=sn_base*signal factor/400

functions/gnsslog2obs.m.contract: dclk=c*DriftNanosPerSecond/1e9 in m/s; raw epoch timing and observations are formed before residual filtering

fgo_gnss.m.contract: residuals -> exobs_residuals -> residual recomputation -> observation error model -> P/D/TDCP graph

parameters.m.contract: D residual 3 m/s (non-init), P residual 20/15 m, P-D 40/20 m, L-D 1.5 m, time interval 1.5 s

already_implemented: Android raw status/range/clock masks from exobs.m in android_raw_gnss.cpp
two-sided raw P-D and L-D equations and 1.5 s pair gate in observable_upstream_preprocessing.hpp
MATLAB midpoint-rank SNR p85 and signal factors/ratios
global system-by-band pseudorange residual center in fgo_problems.cpp when the historical upstream-quality flag is enabled

mismatches.upstream: absolute abs(resD-dclk/obs.dt) threshold, with dclk from raw DriftNanosPerSecond or a documented phone-specific estimate
mismatches.native: per-epoch median of receiver-only residual_mps, thresholded by 3 m/s, only in the broader upstream-quality lane
mismatches.impact: raw clock drift is not retained in ObservationData, and median centering can retain a common-mode bad D set or remove a valid row

mismatches.upstream: residuals are recomputed after exobs_residuals before obserrmodel/graph
mismatches.native: seed residuals are computed during factor preparation; no second native satellite residual pass exists
mismatches.impact: exact second-pass parity needs a separate SPP/Gsat residual representation and is not selected for this bounded phase
mismatches.evidence: upstream fgo_gnss.m:50-82; native fgo_problems.cpp factor construction

mismatches.upstream: SNR p85 D sigma=sn_base/12 before graph
mismatches.native: available only with use_upstream_observable_quality; legacy raw lane uses fixed/elevation sigma and optimizer Huber
mismatches.impact: already exposed as a separate rejected Phase13 candidate; not bundled into the new isolated screen

selection.selected_component: preserve raw DriftNanosPerSecond as epoch receiver clock range-rate and apply the upstream absolute D residual gate to receiver-only native D factors
selection.why_selected: It is the only clearly unported residual rejection rule with an available raw Android source field and a fixed published threshold; it is smaller and more attributable than repeating the entire Gsat/SPP pass.

not_selected.repeated_full_residual_pass: requires an unimplemented Gsat residual state and would change more than one component
not_selected.SNR_weighting: already implemented behind Phase13 and its Pixel score was a No-Go
not_selected.P_global_ISB: already implemented and separately recorded as the v2.1 exactness No-Go
